result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator appears over a restaurant card image even though the card content is otherwise displayed.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is visible in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image card, making the card look unfinished or stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image/card has loaded, or replace it with a proper skeleton/loading state before the content appears.
